description: This file defines data classes and interfaces related to content metadata, API interactions, and an in-memory store for rated content in a media content application.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Data class representing a media content item with id, title, poster URL, and rolling credits time.

classes.name: ApaMetadata
classes.description: Data class containing optional invitation copy metadata for content.

classes.name: ApaAssets
classes.description: Data class holding a map of asset icons associated with content.

classes.name: LikeResult
classes.description: Data class indicating success status of a like action.

classes.name: ContentApi
classes.description: Interface defining method to retrieve content details by ID.

classes.name: ApaMetadataApi
classes.description: Interface defining method to retrieve metadata for content by ID.

classes.name: ApaAssetsApi
classes.description: Interface defining method to retrieve assets for content by ID.

classes.name: LikesApi
classes.description: Interface defining method to send a like with a rating for content.

classes.name: InMemoryRatedStore
classes.description: Class providing in-memory storage to track whether content has been rated.

methods.name: isRated
methods.description: Checks if a content item has been rated.

methods.name: markRated
methods.description: Marks a content item as rated.
